properties.name: First expedition: through Qishan to Jieting
properties.name_zh: 第一次北伐：出祁山，失街亭
properties.text: Three commanderies go over; Ma Su loses Jieting and the army falls back.
properties.text_zh: 三郡叛魏响应，马谡失街亭，全军撤回。

properties.name: First expedition: Zhao Yun's decoy at Ji Valley
properties.name_zh: 第一次北伐：赵云出箕谷为疑兵
properties.text: The decoy column that drew Cao Zhen's main army.

properties.name: Second expedition: the siege of Chencang
properties.text: Hao Zhao holds Chencang for twenty days; Wang Shuang dies in the pursuit. (Winter 228–229.)
properties.text_zh: 郝昭坚守陈仓二十余日，蜀军粮尽而退，斩追将王双。（228年冬至229年初）

properties.name: Third expedition: Wudu and Yinping
properties.name_zh: 第三次北伐：取武都、阴平
properties.text: The one lasting gain of the northern campaigns.
properties.text_zh: 历次北伐中唯一长期守住的战果。

properties.name: Fourth expedition: Qishan, Shanggui and Mumen
properties.name_zh: 第四次北伐：出祁山，割上邽之麦，木门道射杀张郃
properties.text: Wooden oxen carry the grain; Zhang He is killed at Mumen in the retreat.
properties.text_zh: 以木牛运粮；退兵时于木门道射杀张郃。

properties.name: Fifth expedition: up the Xie Valley to Wuzhang Plains
properties.name_zh: 第五次北伐：出斜谷，屯五丈原
properties.text: A hundred days facing Sima Yi across the Wei; Zhuge Liang dies in camp.
properties.text_zh: 与司马懿隔渭水对峙百余日，诸葛亮病逝军中。
